rules.cwe_name: Dead Code
rules.description: If a dollar assertion '$' appears in a regular expression before another term that cannot match the empty string, then this assertion can never match, so the entire regular expression cannot match any string.

rules.cwe_name: Use of Potentially Dangerous Function
rules.description: The 'eval' function and the 'Function' constructor execute strings as code. This is dangerous and impedes program analysis and understanding. Consequently, these two functions should not be used.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Resource Identifiers ('Resource Injection')
rules.description: creating arbitrary environment variables from user controlled data is not secure

rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: A jQuery plugin that unintentionally constructs HTML from some of its options may be unsafe to use for clients.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
rules.description: Using externally controlled strings to construct code may allow a malicious user to execute arbitrary code.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Web Functionality from an Untrusted Source
rules.description: Including functionality from an untrusted source may allow an attacker to control the functionality and execute arbitrary code.

rules.cwe_name: Expression is Always True
rules.description: Comparing the result of a typeof test against a string other than 'undefined', 'boolean', 'number', 'string', 'object', 'function' or 'symbol' is useless, since this comparison can never succeed.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
rules.description: Recursively merging a user-controlled object into another object can allow an attacker to modify the built-in Object prototype, and possibly escalate to remote code execution or cross-site scripting.

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Block Delimitation
rules.description: The body of a control statement should have appropriate indentation to clarify which statements it controls and which ones it does not control.

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Type Conversion or Cast
rules.description: An attempt to use a value that is not an object or 'null' as a prototype will either be ignored or result in a runtime error.
